entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Nou jwenn." t="It's come to this." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Atansyon, grenade!" t="Watch out! Grenade!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men lanmò nou." t="Death comes." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men lanmò nou." t="Vine moartea." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="An nou tou fini ak tou sa." t="Let's end this." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="An nou tou fini ak tou sa." t="Hai să terminăm cu asta." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tonnè, se pou toutbon?!" t="Shit, seriously?!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tonnè, se pou toutbon?!" t="Căcat, serios?!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wap peye sa kan menm!" t="You'll pay for that!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wap peye sa kan menm!" t="O să plătești pentru asta!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mem pa w!" t="For you!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mem pa w!" t="Pentru tine!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Map vale souf ou." t="I'll swallow your light." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Map vale souf ou." t="Îți înghit lumina." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Lage... m..." t="Release... me..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Lage... m..." t="Eliberează... mă..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: No more?
entries.ro: Nu mai e?

entries.en: We are not finished.
entries.ro: Nu am terminat.

entries.en: What? Now you talk?
entries.ro: Ce? Acum vorbești?

entries.en: Ready now?
entries.ro: Gata acum?

entries.en: V, focus.
entries.ro: V, concentrare.

entries.en: Why we wait?
entries.ro: De ce așteptăm?

entries.en: Hmph?
entries.ro: Hmph?

entries.en: What you want?
entries.ro: Ce vrei?

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kanpe kote w ye a." t="Keep your distance." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kanpe kote w ye a." t="Ține-te la distanță!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pa konmanse non. Pa konmanse." t="Don't start with me." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pa konmanse non. Pa konmanse." t="Nu mă provoca." b="" a=""/>
